description: Java class EnforcementScheduler extending Akka AbstractActor, responsible for scheduling and managing enforcement tasks, keeping track of in-flight tasks, handling completion, and dispatching enforced messages within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: EnforcementScheduler
classes.description: An actor class that schedules enforcement tasks, manages their lifecycle, and dispatches enforcement messages.

classes.name: Futures
classes.description: Represents the in-flight enforcement futures for a specific entity, including methods to append and reduce reference counts.

classes.name: FutureComplete
classes.description: Internal class signaling completion of enforcement tasks, with associated entity ID and optional error.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method to create Props for actor initialization.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor.

methods.name: scheduleEnforcement
methods.description: Handles scheduling new enforcement tasks, updating the cache of ongoing tasks.

methods.name: futureComplete
methods.description: Handles completion signals for enforcement tasks, updating the futures cache.

methods.name: dispatchEnforcedMessage
methods.description: Dispatches the enforcement result message to the appropriate receiver or pipes the future.

methods.name: scheduleTaskAfter
methods.description: Schedules enforcement tasks after previous futures, ensuring order and dependency management.

methods.name: sendFutureComplete
methods.description: Creates a message to self indicating a task has completed, optionally with an error.

methods.name: initial
methods.description: Returns an initial Futures object with no in-flight tasks.

methods.name: appendBeforeStartFuture
methods.description: Returns a new Futures object with an added in-flight task that starts before enforcement begins.

methods.name: appendBeforeCompleteFuture
methods.description: Returns a new Futures object with an added in-flight task that completes after enforcement.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Reduces the reference count, indicating completion of a task.
